title: Capturing AI’s Attention: Physics of Repetition, Hallucination, Bias and Beyond

bias_targets.methodology: Theoretical modeling using a physics-based Hamiltonian analogy of the Attention mechanism. The paper evaluates bias by applying an orthogonal linear perturbation matrix to token embeddings and pre-trained weight matrices to calculate how it shifts the phase boundary between 'good' and 'bad' (e.g., harmful or hallucinatory) output token probabilities.
